senses.gloss: m.(b. h. רֹגֶז; רָגַז)excitement, anger, commotion, trouble.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>מתיך ר׳ רחמים</he> out of the divine anger comes mercy (ref. to <cite ref="Habakkuk 3:2">Hab. III, 2</cite>).
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 38:3">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVIII</cite> <he>התחיל מקלל רוֹגְזָם וכ׳</he> he began to curse his sons’ anger.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:3">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 3:26">Job III, 26</cite>) <he>בא עלי רָגְזוֹ וכ׳</he> the trouble about Joseph came upon me.
